description: Perform a 'Product Sunsetting' workflow for the 'Vintage Camera Lens'. Navigate to the product in the WooCommerce admin panel and perform three actions: 1) Change its Catalog Visibility to 'Hidden' (in the Publish sidebar). 2) Change its Inventory status to 'Out of stock' (in Product Data > Inventory). 3) Update the Product Short Description by appending exactly this text: '**DISCONTINUED: This item is no longer available.**'. Save the product changes.

metadata.expected_notice_text: **DISCONTINUED: This item is no longer available.**
